evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative directive with absolute intensifier 'entirely' — the speaker is issuing an operational instruction to remove knowledge, not arguing a position.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Operational directive with exhaustive scope ('all knowledge about…') — the speaker expects this to be acted on, not debated.
Performed declarative establishing a settled fact with absolute 'never' — stated as conclusion, not as a position being argued.
